reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a concrete composition, baseline, operating range, measurable improvement, and controlled falsification test, whereas B leaves the host alloy, tungsten concentration, and mechanical acceptance threshold undefined and provides no supporting evidence. A remains mechanistically questionable—Cu nanoparticles are unlikely to be coherent with a W-based HEA or form continuous conduction pathways at 5–10 vol%—but these claims are directly testable and its proposal is more actionable.
